cohort: The study included 96 infants who were prenatally exposed to the Zika virus during gestation, born between March 2016 and April 2017 without congenital Zika syndrome, and asymptomatic at birth.
finding: Language delay at 12 months was significantly associated with a smaller head circumference Z-score at birth in infants prenatally exposed to the Zika virus and asymptomatic.
